newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rebounds of overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rebounds of overseas demand.

text.p: Tin price rebounded seven cents to close at 14.97 ringgit ($5.98) a kg as there were shortcovering from overseas despite falls in London.
Traders said there were bids of 124 tonnes at the opening and offers at 65 tonnes. Final turnover was 93 tonnes, against 123 on Friday with buying mainly from Europe and Malaysia.

"There was a lot of shortcovering from overseas after Friday's fall," a trader said, adding that the near-term trend depends mainly on the performance of London's copper. The local price differential over London was at $40 a tonne premium against $5 previously.Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911)($1=2.5030 rgt).
